edits.rationale: Moderate global alpha_v reduction, smaller than -1.0 so nominal driving is slowed less.
Wet gate on h1 unit 0, dead on nominal, reading friction_est.
Drive dead h2 unit 0 when wet.

hypothesis: Global alpha_v shifts of -0.8 to -1.0 lowered the wet-curve peak lateral acceleration ratio below 1.0, but -1.0 slowed nominal driving too much (one nominal seed failed). A smaller global shift of -0.6 combined with the friction_est-gated reduction (about -0.65 on wet states, zero on nominal) should give wet states a total drop near -1.2 while nominal sees only -0.6.
expected_effect: Wet-curve lat accel ratio falls below 1.0 on most seeds, and nominal episodes still complete with a milder slowdown than -1.0. This combined plan was not verified by rollout because the budget ran out.
